evals.prompt: Create a stakeholder overview document from accepted project knowledge.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-document, uses the customer_spec retrieval policy when durable knowledge is needed, writes under .work-bundle/orchestration/docs/, omits unsupported facts, and does not write durable knowledge.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation specification for the work-bundle migration.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-specification, writes a Markdown spec under .work-bundle/orchestration/spec/active/, updates spec index, and includes execution context.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation plan from an active specification.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-implementation-plan, creates root plan, phase files, task files, and plan index under .work-bundle/orchestration/plan/active/.

evals.prompt: Execute the next task in an existing plan.
evals.expected_output: Selects execute-plan, checks sub-agent support, uses the single-agent fallback when sub-agents are unavailable, executes one task, updates task and phase task status, reports concise execution result, and requires an executor handoff.

evals.prompt: Create an executor-result handoff after implementation.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-handoff, writes a sparse YAML executor-result handoff under .work-bundle/orchestration/handoff/executor/active/, includes fields by applicability, rejects forbidden executor advice fields, updates the handoff index, and does not create an active orchestration handoff or retrieve durable knowledge during execution completion.

evals.prompt: Execute a phase whose next two tasks are independent and have disjoint write scopes, in an environment with sub-agents.
evals.expected_output: Selects execute-plan, uses the sub-agent scheduler path, delegates the independent tasks to multiple sub-agents, waits for completion, validates executor handoffs against task/phase/plan/spec, updates task statuses, and continues scheduling.

evals.prompt: A sub-agent reports completion but its executor handoff omits validation evidence.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the compact handoff as invalid by applicability, does not mark the task complete, records the blocker, and requires corrected sparse YAML validation evidence before advancing.

evals.prompt: Finish the last task in a phase and then the last phase in a plan.
evals.expected_output: Creates sparse YAML phase-scoped and plan-scoped executor-result handoffs, updates phase and plan statuses to Completed, does not create an active orchestration handoff, reports review-plan as the next action, and does not archive artifacts.

evals.prompt: Review an implemented plan where the project files do not satisfy the source specification.
evals.expected_output: Selects review-plan, audits accepted task-review and workflow evidence without redoing code review, routes an implementation rejection to the task repair loop, and creates a specification repair only when evidence proves a requirement, design, or authority defect.

evals.prompt: Review an implemented plan where all specification, plan, handoff, and project file checks pass.
evals.expected_output: Selects review-plan, audits accepted task-review evidence, fresh validation, handoffs, knowledge disposition, and finalization gates; archives and refreshes indexes only after every required gate passes.

evals.prompt: Doctor the orchestrator skill for installation health, malformed orch skills, and workflow bias.
evals.expected_output: Selects orch-doctor, uses dev-rules-doctor first, runs the develop-rules doctor command, audits orch skill files, workflow, evals, helper commands, and cross-skill v3 gateway wiring read-only, checks that orch-execute-plan preserves both sub-agent scheduler and single-agent fallback paths, verifies archival belongs to orch-review-plan, and reports concrete repairs without changing files.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation plan from v3 retrieved context containing authority, candidate, background, and blocked notes.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-implementation-plan, maps the workflow to the implementation_plan retrieval policy, carries authority context into executable tasks, labels candidate/background/blocked context separately, and does not create tasks from non-authority notes.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation specification from v3 project knowledge where customer-design notes match the query.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-specification, maps the workflow to the implementation_spec policy, treats development-design and implementation notes as authority, labels customer-design notes as supporting background or constraints, and cites source paths without treating background as implementation authority.

evals.prompt: Review a completed plan that should promote a confirmed note to implemented.
evals.expected_output: Selects review-plan, requires validation evidence suitable for front matter evidence before recommending implemented status, and does not silently write durable knowledge.

evals.prompt: Execute a task whose resolved target source repository has an unrelated untracked file before execution starts.
evals.expected_output: Selects execute-plan, runs read-only repository preflight before selection, capability checks, delegation, or implementation, blocks the task because the target repository is dirty, records repository-specific changed-path evidence, and does not stash, commit, reset, restore, clean, delete, or otherwise mutate the repository.

evals.prompt: Execute a scheduler wave whose task write scopes resolve to two target source repositories, where one repository is clean and the other is dirty.
evals.expected_output: Resolves and records both target source repositories separately from the orchestration artifact repository, runs read-only preflight for both, blocks the entire scheduler wave because one target repository is dirty, reports status and changed-path evidence per repository, and makes no implementation changes.

evals.prompt: Review a completed plan whose validated implementation introduces a new source-of-truth rule that should become durable project knowledge.
evals.expected_output: Selects review-plan, identifies a structural update, keeps knowledge-update disposition required, delegates the mixed specification, plan, handoff, validation, and changed-file evidence to ks-extract-valuable-points, validates returned durable paths or an evidence-backed no-write rationale plus index rebuild status, resumes disposition evaluation, and never writes durable knowledge directly.

evals.prompt: Review a completed plan with a structural update when ks-extract-valuable-points cannot run in the active environment.
evals.expected_output: Selects review-plan, keeps knowledge-update disposition required or blocked, does not archive, reports an actionable ks-extract-valuable-points delegation input and next action, and does not treat unavailable or incomplete delegation evidence as completed or not-needed.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation specification when the gateway returns no durable note supports the current purpose.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-specification, records the gateway query and retrieval gap in Source Context, analyzes the user purpose from prompt and repository evidence, asks Design Interrogation questions only for unresolved intent with recommended answers, does not block solely because no supporting note exists, and sets Knowledge Base Update required when the accepted conclusion creates reusable workflow policy.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation specification when material candidate knowledge conflicts with the user purpose.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-specification, labels the material candidate as non-authority evidence, records it as rationale, traceability, conflict evidence, or open-question input, does not promote the candidate into requirements, and keeps the quality gate blocked until the material conflict is resolved.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation plan from a specification whose quality gate is verified.
evals.expected_output: Confirms the source specification records Source Context, compact semantic_loop convergence, Open Questions, Knowledge Base Update, execution-workspace policy, and `Quality gate: verified`; planning then derives normalized tasks and verifies source-ID, dependency, validation, methodology, and executor-context completeness.

evals.prompt: Execute a plan task with a delegated sub-agent, then prepare its executor-result handoff after implementation reveals a task-scoped gap.
evals.expected_output: Preserves preflight, accepted baseline, dependencies, and write scopes; compiles a self-contained task brief; repairs the task-local gap, reruns fresh validation, writes a sparse handoff, compiles a bounded review package, and requires an accept review before completion.

evals.prompt: Execute a source-inspection task when the target repository has no .codegraph directory and effective prefer_subagent resolves to false.
evals.expected_output: Selects execute-plan, records that CodeGraph is skipped because the repository is not indexed, preserves text-search fallback, uses the single-agent fallback for exactly one task, keeps execution no-retrieval, does not require any additional runtime preference file, and does not bypass repository preflight, dependency checks, write-scope checks, or executor-result handoff requirements.

evals.prompt: Execute a task whose write scope resolves to one indexed repository and one repository without a .codegraph directory.
evals.expected_output: Selects execute-plan, records independent compact CodeGraph evidence per target, runs sync only for the indexed repository after preflight, records no-index with applicable false and up_to_date false for the unindexed repository, and does not initialize CodeGraph.

evals.prompt: Execute a source-inspection task in an indexed Git repository where codegraph sync succeeds.
evals.expected_output: Runs repository preflight first, then codegraph sync with the absolute repository root, performs a task-relevant graph query before broad inspection or editing, reruns preflight after sync, and records compact root, applicability, up_to_date, and required sync/query evidence in the executor-result handoff.

evals.prompt: Execute a source-inspection task where codegraph sync fails and strict graph gating is not required.
evals.expected_output: Records compact sync-failed CodeGraph evidence, uses bounded direct-file or text-search fallback, continues only after preserving repository preflight and scope checks, and includes only the required failure and fallback facts in the executor-result handoff.

evals.prompt: Complete a task that changed indexed source files in a CodeGraph-enabled Git repository.
evals.expected_output: Runs post-change codegraph sync before final graph impact validation and before the executor-result handoff, records compact up_to_date or blocker evidence, and blocks if sync causes unexplained tracked or unignored Git changes.

evals.prompt: Schedule two parallel tasks that both target the same CodeGraph-enabled repository.
evals.expected_output: Serializes codegraph sync operations for that repository, avoids concurrent access to the same index, permits only safe parallel implementation work after sync/query gates, and records compact per-task repository and CodeGraph evidence.

evals.prompt: Execute a scheduler wave with visible multi-agent subagents available and safe disjoint task scopes.
evals.expected_output: Delegates task ownership only to visible multi-agent subagents, records compact delegation_evidence with each visible_reference when provided, sets internal_spawn_used_for_task_delegation to false, validates sparse executor-result handoffs, rejects cross-conversation delegation as a task ownership vehicle, and preserves preflight and scope gates.

evals.prompt: Execute a plan task when only invisible internal spawn workers are available for delegation.
evals.expected_output: Rejects invisible internal spawn workers as the task delegation vehicle, uses single-agent fallback for one task when valid or reports a delegation-visibility blocker, and does not mark delegated execution complete without compact visible delegation_evidence.

evals.prompt: Execute a delegated task while an internal helper worker is used only for bounded snippet comparison.
evals.expected_output: Allows the helper-worker support because visible multi-agent subagent ownership remains intact, records internal helper usage in compact delegation_evidence, keeps internal_spawn_used_for_task_delegation false, and requires the visible executor handoff to own validation and task_fit_check evidence.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation plan where backend and frontend work can run in parallel after an API boundary is stable.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-implementation-plan, creates or confirms a boundary artifact first, uses api-contract-first or another suitable decoupling strategy, assigns parallel tasks only with disjoint write scopes and explicit dependencies, rejects unsafe overlap, and adds a convergence validation task for the branch group.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation specification from a long optimization request with supplied screenshots and reference files.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-specification, creates the active specification shell before long evidence gathering, records Initial User Purpose Evidence only from the current request and visible supplied artifacts, adds Draft Requirement Breakdown, then revises the draft after bounded evidence gathering without silently replacing the original purpose.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation specification when relevant notes outside the implementation_spec lifecycle match the requested feature.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-specification, uses neutral cross-stage discovery through ks-what-is-helpful, treats implementation_spec only as classification and output-grouping intent, records neutral anchors and candidate sources or retrieval gaps, and does not discovery-filter candidates to implementation_spec lifecycle partitions before authority classification.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation specification when current authority evidence materially opposes the user's requested workflow change.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-specification, surfaces the opposing or constraining evidence as agent-classified conflict or open-question input, keeps non-authority evidence non-shaping unless user resolution or promoted authority changes it, and blocks the quality gate until the material conflict is resolved.

evals.prompt: Execute downstream plan tasks from a verified specification that already carries accepted knowledge context.
evals.expected_output: Selects execute-plan, uses context carried by the specification, plan, phase, task, and declared handoffs, does not run durable knowledge retrieval, does not read .work-bundle/knowledge/**, and does not require downstream knowledge-base lookup.

evals.prompt: Execute a contract-decoupled phase where backend and frontend participants share a stable API contract and both participant handoffs have reached BAR-001.
evals.expected_output: Releases BAR-001 only after every participant has completed or blocked with executor-result handoffs, schedules the convergence owner after the barrier, validates against the common contract and accepted participant handoffs, records participants_complete_or_blocked true, and does not treat sibling in-progress implementation as pre-barrier validation authority.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation plan for a broad workflow change that can be expressed as one compact phase with a shared contract task, two disjoint branch tasks, and one convergence task.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-implementation-plan, prefers the compact one-phase structure, proves full spec-ID coverage, preserves exact paths, dependencies, write-scope separation, validation ownership, handoff requirements, common contract group metadata, barrier release criteria, and convergence ownership.

evals.prompt: Create a WorkBundle implementation specification for a scope that matches active violation registry entries.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-specification, inspects the WorkBundle violation registry without browsing .work-bundle/knowledge/**, includes related active violations as blocking Open Questions with severity, related scope, required resolution, and expected review closure, and treats exact-current-work conflicts as specification-owned when applicable.

evals.prompt: Review a completed WorkBundle plan whose source specification included active violation evidence and whose implementation passed unblocked validation.
evals.expected_output: Selects review-plan, validates implementation and handoff evidence, closes resolved specification-included violations with the approved lifecycle action before archive, records violation_closure evidence, does not delete evidence files, keeps unrelated violations untouched, and blocks archive if included violation closure cannot be completed.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation specification when project source metadata is stale but the durable-knowledge gateway is accessible.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-specification, blocks trusted source inspection and downstream planning on the metadata blocker, still runs bounded knowledge gateway retrieval, classifies retrieved supporting, opposing, constraining, candidate, background, blocked, and irrelevant notes before use, keeps retrieval read/classification-only, and does not let the stale source baseline alone imply durable note staleness.

evals.prompt: Create and later review a specification that carries material candidate or opposite evidence in Open Questions.
evals.expected_output: Records material non-authority or opposite evidence in Open Questions with an explicit blocking yes/no classification, does not convert non-authority evidence into requirements solely because it is relevant, and during review settles each material item as resolved, no longer applicable, delegated through approved ks-* follow-up, still blocked, or explicitly non-blocking with rationale before archive.

evals.prompt: Execute a task from a deep directory inside a managed multi-repository workspace member.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the containing workspace_root for .work-bundle orchestration, workspace AGENTS.md, script/index.yaml, and project rules; keeps repository preflight, source edits, tests, commits, and CodeGraph scoped to the selected member project_root; and does not use the registered origin path as the normal writable checkout.

evals.prompt: Register the built-in wb-credential-use and wb-migrate-to-multi-repository skills in the runtime skill registry.
evals.expected_output: Refuses the registry mutation because the bootstrap-resolved runtime registry is external-skills-only, keeps both built-in skills toolkit-owned and discoverable through WorkBundle skill surfaces, and creates no registry proposal or merge.

evals.prompt: Delegate a task that names a workspace credential ID and a read-only operation.
evals.expected_output: Invokes wb-credential-use and transmits only credential ID, redacted target, requested operation, and authorization context; never reads or transfers credential values; and records only redacted executor evidence.

evals.prompt: Run final review after every task already has an accepted independent task review.
evals.expected_output: orch-review-plan audits workflow, handoff, knowledge, and finalization evidence and does not inspect source code quality again.

evals.prompt: Final review finds one completed task has no task-review verdict.
evals.expected_output: Returns review-blocked and resumes the owning execution review step; it does not create a repair specification.

evals.prompt: Final review proves the specification contains the wrong API requirement.
evals.expected_output: Routes to specification repair because the defect is requirement authority, while keeping implementation artifacts unarchived.

evals.prompt: A completed plan still has Knowledge Base Update disposition required and no ks return.
evals.expected_output: Returns knowledge-blocked and prevents archive until approved ks return evidence resolves the disposition.

evals.prompt: A draft specification semantic view finds one missing constraint and the next view is unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Repairs only the missing constraint, records compact semantic_loop rounds and repaired evidence, and converges without a verbose transcript.

evals.prompt: A generated plan omits one spec ID and has an incorrect dependency.
evals.expected_output: Semantic convergence repairs source-ID coverage and dependency scope, re-views all plan lenses, and reports converged only when unchanged.

evals.prompt: Plan a low-judgment two-file implementation with exact commands and stable interfaces.
evals.expected_output: Allocates executor_profile capability mechanical, context_mode compiled-brief, exact validation, and a self-contained ephemeral task brief.

evals.prompt: Compile a task brief whose task cites exact requirement and API IDs.
evals.expected_output: Resolves exact values from cited source artifacts, fails closed on missing IDs, and does not retrieve or read the knowledge base.

evals.prompt: Execute a task that changes testable production behavior.
evals.expected_output: Requires a meaningful failing behavior test, verifies the expected red reason, implements minimally, verifies green, refactors, and reruns relevant regression tests.

evals.prompt: Execute a configuration-only task with deterministic schema validation.
evals.expected_output: Uses direct methodology and the exact deterministic check; it does not invent a fake failing test.

evals.prompt: Fix an unexpected retry bug with no established root cause.
evals.expected_output: Uses systematic debugging to reproduce, compare, test one hypothesis, and establish root cause before a test-first repair.

evals.prompt: An independent task reviewer finds a blocking correctness defect.
evals.expected_output: Returns repair with compact evidence, routes to the same task implementer, reruns fresh validation, regenerates the package from the original base, and re-reviews.

evals.prompt: A mechanical executor receives a second repeated repair rejection.
evals.expected_output: Escalates provider-neutral capability one tier or routes a semantic defect instead of retrying indefinitely.

evals.prompt: A lightweight mechanical plan discovers an unresolved cross-repository API compatibility decision.
evals.expected_output: Stops with decision-blocked and escalates to full orchestration instead of growing the lightweight plan.

evals.prompt: Cleanup is requested for an execution worktree whose provenance owner is user.
evals.expected_output: Refuses deletion because only WorkBundle-owned workspaces with matching Git identity may be cleaned.

evals.prompt: Hydrate a temporary worktree profile containing a credential-inject entry.
evals.expected_output: Uses the protected credential boundary and never copies or emits credential values in prompts, packets, logs, or files.

evals.prompt: Hydrate .codegraph into an isolated execution checkout.
evals.expected_output: Defaults to regenerate or sync in the target checkout and does not blindly copy or symlink local index state.

evals.prompt: Report that a task is complete using test output captured before the final edit.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the completion claim because the evidence is stale and obtains fresh claim-relevant evidence.

evals.prompt: Report review-complete while a required durable knowledge update is unresolved.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the terminal claim and returns knowledge-blocked until the disposition and index refresh are resolved.

evals.prompt: Execute a bounded task whose compiled brief is valid and complete.
evals.expected_output: Uses the brief, task-scoped source and tests, and allocated methodology without requiring full specification, root-plan, and phase reads; full artifacts remain an escalation path.

evals.prompt: Plan a simplification whose most consequential assumption can be checked with one ordinary characterization task.
evals.expected_output: Places that ordinary task first so it cheaply falsifies the assumption before broad edits; it does not add a checkpoint phase, risk score, or parallel lifecycle.

evals.prompt: Compile a heavy task whose accepted Truth Basis has conflict_status escalate.
evals.expected_output: Stops with decision-blocked for authority repair and does not delegate or edit.

evals.prompt: An executor reports knowledge_disposition update and asks to invoke a ks-* writer.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the persistence instruction; the executor returns only task-local disposition evidence and final orchestration review owns approved ks-* follow-up.

evals.prompt: Review a heavy task whose implementation and tests do not match the compiled Truth Basis.
evals.expected_output: Returns repair after comparing accepted purpose, source evidence, decision authority, expected delta, test oracle, and disposition.

evals.prompt: Resolve v4 repository context when portable project metadata and device-local checkout observations disagree.
evals.expected_output: Keeps project.yaml as portable project/topology authority, resolves local observations only from bootstrap-resolved project_registry device_bindings, and blocks the contradiction without restoring v3 local fields.

evals.prompt: Create a specification for retiring a producer when current source evidence shows an existing downstream consumer that the user did not mention.
evals.expected_output: Builds a bounded current-state impact basis, records the consumer as a material relation, and blocks verification until it is accepted and projected to stable IDs or excluded with evidence; omission from the request is not an exclusion reason.

evals.prompt: Create a specification for a greenfield isolated utility after a bounded current-state scan finds no material upstream, downstream, validation, or dirty-work relations.
evals.expected_output: Records impact_decisions none_relevant with the searched boundary, reason, and stopping_reason, then permits verification without inventing legacy impact.

evals.prompt: Current-state evidence fully explains a material relation and is not contradictory, but a reviewer asks for mandatory full-history archaeology before specification verification.
evals.expected_output: Declines mandatory archaeology, records the current-state evidence and stopping reason, and escalates to targeted Git history, prior work artifacts, execution evidence, or durable knowledge only for contradiction, unresolved ownership, regression causality, or governing legacy decisions.

evals.prompt: A material current relation has unresolved ownership and could change the accepted API contract.
evals.expected_output: Marks the relation blocking, creates a blocking open question, keeps Quality gate blocked, and uses targeted provenance evidence to resolve ownership rather than silently accepting or excluding it.

evals.prompt: An impact scan finds one relation that is merely adjacent and cannot change an accepted contract surface, plus another relation whose disposition can change a user-observable outcome and validation target.
evals.expected_output: Stops traversing the related-but-non-material relation with a recorded reason, treats the outcome-changing relation as material, and requires accepted, excluded, or blocking disposition because it can change a user-observable or contractual outcome, architectural boundary, measurable quality target, validation target, or declared boundary.

evals.prompt: Create a specification for a user-visible request with no evidenced adjacent improvement after one compact evidence-routed pass.
evals.expected_output: Records excellence_applicability as no_material_opportunity with a non-empty evidence-backed reason and an empty proposal list; it does not manufacture a recommendation merely because the request is user-visible.

evals.prompt: A bounded architecture opportunity could materially improve maintainability, but the user has not answered the proposal.
evals.expected_output: Records user value, evidence, cost, risk, recommendation, and disposition; defaults the unanswered proposal to deferred and excludes it from authoritative scope, planning, executor briefs, and acceptance obligations.

evals.prompt: A specification author discovers an evidence-backed GUI clarity improvement and silently implements a deferred proposal while compiling the plan.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the silent scope expansion; the deferred proposal remains traceable but non-authoritative and absent from planning and executor briefs until explicitly accepted.

evals.prompt: The user accepts an evidence-backed excellence proposal during Design Interrogation.
evals.expected_output: Requires the accepted proposal to project through stable authoritative requirement, constraint, interface, acceptance-criterion, or validation-target IDs before verification and planning.

evals.prompt: An agent runs a universal product-quality checklist covering GUI, architecture, performance, and accessibility for a narrow backend repair with no material evidence for those dimensions.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the universal product-quality checklist, selects dimensions only from task evidence and change shape, and records no_material_opportunity when no material adjacent improvement exists.

evals.prompt: An optional excellence proposal is rejected, while another proposal reveals an unresolved safety authority conflict.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the rejected proposal traceable and excluded without blocking, but routes the unresolved safety authority conflict through the existing blocking open-question rules; optionality does not bypass safety authority.

evals.prompt: An excellence scan finds one adjacent idea that cannot change an accepted contract surface and another option whose acceptance could change a user-observable outcome and validation target.
evals.expected_output: Omits the related-but-non-material adjacent idea or records it not_material, surfaces the outcome-changing option as a proposal because accepting or rejecting it could change a requirement, constraint, acceptance criterion, user-observable or contractual outcome, architectural boundary, measurable quality target, validation target, or declared boundary, and stops when further exploration can change none of those surfaces with the reason recorded.

evals.prompt: A planner allocates source_ids: [EXC-001] for a deferred excellence proposal while compiling an implementation plan.
evals.expected_output: Rejects EXC-* proposal IDs as non-authoritative; planning and the compiled brief use only the stable requirement, constraint, interface, acceptance-criterion, or validation-target IDs that an accepted proposal projected to.

v4_evals.description: Given a request to preserve deprecated role-context aliases for compatibility, require repository-wide consumer characterization and then remove the skill, rule, CLI, implementation, reference, and positive runtime guidance when no supported external consumer exists; retain only a negative non-reintroduction guard.

Do not confuse stable role profile data used by project initialization and external-skill classification with the obsolete runtime role-context selection subsystem; remove only selection/routing behavior and rewrite positive role-context wording.

v4_evals.prompt: A planner can implement one mechanical increment, but splitting it would only reduce file count while lengthening the evidence loop.
v4_evals.expected_output: Keeps one independently falsifiable increment with minimum orchestration overhead and bounded failure radius; it does not split work merely to minimize task size.

v4_evals.prompt: A task lists a generic requirement source ID as durable decision authority even though the verified specification carried no matching authority note.
v4_evals.expected_output: Rejects the generic source ID because decision authority is semantically distinct; accepts only none-relevant or authority carried by verified specification reconciliation.

v4_evals.prompt: A completed accepted task reports knowledge_disposition update while the specification Knowledge Base Update says not-needed.
v4_evals.expected_output: Promotes final durable closure to required from accepted execution evidence and blocks archive until the approved ks return is validated.

v4_evals.prompt: A rejected task reports knowledge_disposition supersede, while every accepted task reports none.
v4_evals.expected_output: Ignores the rejected disposition, retains the upstream no-write outcome, and does not invoke durable closure from rejected evidence.
